details:
AURORA – Lunar Outpost Survival Simulator

AURORA is an interactive browser-based survival management game that explores the challenges of sustaining a four-person human outpost on the Moon.

The player assumes the role of Mission Commander and oversees four fictional astronauts: Alex Morgan, Ethan Carter, Maya Quinn White, and Noah Williams. The objective is to sustain the crew throughout a 30-day lunar mission by managing limited resources, maintaining infrastructure, responding to emergencies, and making strategic decisions.

The game is designed around interconnected resource-management systems, including oxygen, water, food, electricity, battery reserves, crew health, and equipment maintenance. Its simulation incorporates simplified resource production, consumption, storage, recycling, and maintenance mechanics.

AURORA features a top-down drone-style perspective for monitoring the lunar base and selecting facilities, alongside a first person-style room inspection perspective. The interface includes astronaut profiles, base facilities, resource indicators, mission progression, and environmental storytelling.

The gameplay concept includes greenhouse food production, water recycling, oxygen generation, solar energy, battery storage, equipment failures, water leaks, filter damage, crew assignments, and emergency response. Players must balance immediate survival requirements against long-term mission sustainability.

The project aims to make space exploration and resource sustainability more accessible through interactive learning. Instead of simply explaining the difficulties of lunar habitation, AURORA lets players explore the consequences of their decisions in a simulated environment.

The current implementation is an educational game prototype using simplified game parameters. It is not an engineering-grade life-support simulator. Further development focuses on improving simulation accuracy, emergency forecasting, scientific data integration, and gameplay testing.

The project was developed using AI-assisted programming and original visual concept assets. All external resources and AI-assisted contributions are acknowledged in the submission.
